drug_name: Arginine Pyroglutamate, Coleus Forskohlii, Glutamine, Glycine, Mucuna Pruriens, Ornithine Alpha-Ketoglutarate, Dioscorea Villosa, Tyrosine
brand_names: Various compounded or proprietary supplement blends
Amino acid and botanical support complexes
what_its_for: This combination of amino acids and herbal extracts is used as a nutritional supplement that may help support the body's natural hormone balance, promote lean muscle tone, support healthy energy levels, and aid recovery. Arginine pyroglutamate and ornithine alpha-ketoglutarate are amino acids that may support growth hormone release. Glutamine and glycine support muscle recovery and gut health. Mucuna pruriens provides natural L-DOPA to support dopamine levels and mood. Coleus forskohlii may help support metabolism. Dioscorea villosa (wild yam) has been used for hormone-related support. Tyrosine supports mental focus and energy. This is a supplement, NOT a prescription drug, and it has not been approved by the FDA to treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
how_to_take: Take this supplement exactly as directed on your product label or as recommended by your healthcare provider. Most forms come as capsules, tablets, or powder. Swallow capsules or tablets whole with a full glass of water. If using a powder, mix it thoroughly with water or another beverage as instructed. Many amino acid and hormone-support formulas work best when taken on an empty stomach, often 30 to 60 minutes before bedtime or exercise, unless your label states otherwise. Do not crush or chew capsules unless your product label says it is okay.
dosing: Doses vary widely depending on the specific product formulation and your individual health needs. Always follow the dosing instructions printed on your product label or provided by your healthcare provider or pharmacist. A common approach for amino acid blends is one to three servings per day, but your product may differ. Do not take more than the recommended dose thinking it will work faster or better — taking too much may cause side effects. If you are unsure about your dose, ask your pharmacist or healthcare provider before starting.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule. Do not double up or take two doses at the same time to make up for a missed one. Missing an occasional dose of a nutritional supplement is unlikely to cause harm, but try to be consistent for best results.
storage: Store this product at room temperature, between 59°F and 77°F (15°C to 25°C). Keep it away from heat, direct sunlight, and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Keep the container tightly closed when not in use. Keep all supplements out of reach of children and pets. Do not use the product after the expiration date printed on the label. If the product changes color, smell, or texture, stop using it and contact your pharmacist.
what_to_avoid: Avoid taking this supplement with alcohol, as it may increase the risk of side effects such as dizziness or low blood pressure. Avoid taking Mucuna pruriens-containing products if you are already taking levodopa or other dopamine-related medications without first talking to your doctor, as the combination may be too strong. Avoid taking this supplement if you are pregnant or breastfeeding unless specifically approved by your healthcare provider. Do not combine with prescription hormone therapies, MAO inhibitors (MAOIs), antidepressants, blood pressure medications, or thyroid medications without medical guidance. Avoid taking on a full stomach if the label recommends an empty stomach, as this may reduce absorption. Do not use if you have a known allergy to any of the ingredients listed.
when_to_call_doctor: Stop taking this supplement and contact your doctor or go to the nearest emergency room right away if you experience any of the following: severe allergic reaction (hives, swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat, difficulty breathing), chest pain or rapid heartbeat, significant drop in blood pressure (dizziness, fainting, lightheadedness), severe headache, involuntary muscle movements or twitching, extreme mood changes or agitation, nausea or vomiting that does not go away, or signs of liver problems (yellowing of skin or eyes, dark urine, severe stomach pain). Also call your doctor before starting this supplement if you have heart disease, kidney disease, liver disease, diabetes, thyroid disorders, Parkinson's disease, a history of hormone-sensitive conditions (such as certain cancers), or if you take any prescription medications.
when_it_works: Results from nutritional supplements like this blend are generally gradual. Some people may notice improvements in energy, mood, or exercise recovery within two to four weeks of consistent use. Benefits related to muscle tone or body composition may take six to twelve weeks or longer to become noticeable. Individual results vary depending on diet, exercise habits, sleep quality, and overall health. This supplement works best as part of a healthy lifestyle that includes balanced nutrition and regular physical activity.
special_populations: Pregnant or breastfeeding women should NOT use this supplement without explicit approval from their obstetrician or healthcare provider, as the safety of several ingredients during pregnancy and lactation has not been established. Children and teenagers should not use this supplement unless directed by a pediatrician. Older adults (65 years and older) should start with the lowest recommended dose and monitor for side effects such as dizziness or blood pressure changes. Individuals with kidney disease should use caution with high-dose amino acid supplements, as the kidneys process amino acids and an excessive load could be harmful. People with Parkinson's disease or those taking dopaminergic medications should avoid Mucuna pruriens without direct physician supervision due to its natural L-DOPA content. Individuals with hormone-sensitive conditions should consult their oncologist or endocrinologist before use.
